item.name: TMGI Allocation or Timer Expiry Refresh
Request the allocation of TMGI(s) for new MBS session(s) or the refresh of the expiry time of already allocated TMGI(s).

request.name: Request the allocation of TMGI(s) for new MBS session(s) or the refresh of the expiry time of already allocated TMGI(s).

variable.description: apiRoot as defined in clause 5.2.4 of 3GPP TS 29.122.

response.name: OK. Successful case. The allocated TMGI(s) or a refreshed expiry time for the concerned already allocated TMGI(s) is/are returned to the requesting AF.
